rules.name: Agile
rules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

rules.name: Ambush
rules.description: May be set aside before deployment. At the start of any round after the first, may be deployed anywhere over 9” away from enemy units. Players alternate in placing Ambush units, starting with the player that activates next. Units that deploy via Ambush can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they deploy.

rules.name: Ambush Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Ambush. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Anti-Cover
rules.description: This weapon ignores Cover.

rules.name: Anti-Regen
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration.

rules.name: AP
rules.description: AP

rules.name: Counter
rules.description: May strike first with this weapon when charged, unless this unit is Fatigued.

rules.name: Counter in Melee Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Counter on its weapons in melee. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Defense
rules.description: This model gets +X to Defense rolls.

rules.name: Enhanced Agile
rules.description: If this model has Agile, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Agile (instead of only +1" and +2").

rules.name: Enhanced Lustbound
rules.description: If this model has Lustbound, it moves +2" on Advance and +4" on Rush/Charge from Lustbound (instead of only +1" and +2").

rules.name: Enhanced Lustbound Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Enhanced Lustbound. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Hit & Run
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after shooting or being in melee.

rules.name: Hit & Run Fighter
rules.description: Once per round, this model may move by up to 3" after being in melee.

rules.name: Hit & Run Fighter Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Hit & Run Fighter. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Lustbound
rules.description: Moves +1" when using Advance, and +2" when using Rush/Charge.

rules.name: Melee Evasion
rules.description: Enemies get -1 to hit rolls in melee when attacking units where most models have this rule.

rules.name: Obliterate
rules.description: Ignores Regeneration, and when attacking units where most models have Tough(9) or higher, the target must re-roll successful unmodified Defense results of 4-6.

rules.name: Piercing Charge
rules.description: This model gets AP(+1) on its weapons when charging.

rules.name: Piercing Charge Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Piercing Charge. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Quick Shot
rules.description: This model may shoot after using Rush actions.

rules.name: Regeneration
rules.description: When a unit where most models have this rule takes wounds, roll one die for each. On a 5+ it is ignored.

rules.name: Retaliate
rules.description: When this model takes wounds in melee, the attacker takes X hits per wound taken.

rules.name: Sergeant
rules.description: This model gets AP(+1) when attacking.

rules.name: Shred
rules.description: For each unmodified result of 1 to block hits, this weapon deals 1 extra wound.

rules.name: Spawn
rules.description: Once per game, when this model is activated, you may place a new unit of X fully within 6" of it. Units placed via Spawn can’t seize or contest objectives on the round they are placed.

rules.name: Strider
rules.description: May ignore the effects of Difficult terrain. This unit halves the number of dice it rolls when jumping (rounding up).

rules.name: Strider Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Strider. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

rules.name: Tough
rules.description: Once a model has taken as many wounds as its Tough value, it is killed (remove from play).

rules.name: Unpredictable Fighter
rules.description: When in melee, roll one die and apply one effect to all models with this rule: on a 1-3 they get AP(+1) on their weapons, and on a 4-6 they get +1 to hit rolls instead.

rules.name: Unstoppable
rules.description: This weapon ignores Regeneration, and ignores all negative modifiers which are not from this model's special rules.

rules.name: Unstoppable when Shooting Aura
rules.description: This model's unit and up to 2 friendly units picked before the start of the game get Unstoppable on its weapons when shooting. If this model is killed, picked models that are deployed lose the rule.

spells.name: Beautiful Pain
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 12" in line of sight, which takes 4 hits with Obliterate.

spells.name: Blissful Dance
spells.effect: Pick up to three friendly units within 18", which get Melee Evasion once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Combat Ecstasy
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which friendly units gets Quick Shot against once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Lust Boon
spells.effect: Pick up to two friendly units within 12", which get Enhanced Lustbound once (next time the effect would apply).

spells.name: Overpowering Lash
spells.effect: Pick one enemy unit within 18" in line of sight, which takes 6 hits with Shred.

spells.name: Total Seizure
spells.effect: Pick one enemy model within 18" in line of sight, which takes 2 hits with AP(1). This effect is resolved as if the target was a unit of [1].
